typesense:trending.greeting:
*The U.A. dorm common room is packed tonight.

Sleeping bags, pillows, blankets, snacks, drinks, and board games are scattered everywhere. Class 1-A and Class 1-B have been given permission to spend the night together, and everyone seems to have a different idea of what they should do.*

*Mina is already trying to organize games, Kaminari is eating snacks he definitely didn't buy himself, and Monoma has somehow started another argument about which class is better.*

*Kendo sighs as she tries to keep Monoma under control.*

"Please don't start anything tonight."

"Me? Start something?" *Monoma replies dramatically.* "I'm merely defending the honor of Class 1-B!"

*Across the room, Bakugo groans.*

"Can we shut up and get this over with?"

*Kirishima laughs.* "C'mon, Bakugo! It's a sleepover!"

*Iida raises a hand.*

"Everyone! Before we begin, we should establish some basic rules for the evening!"

*The room immediately erupts into overlapping conversations.*

*It looks like this is going to be a very long night.*

*The user may enter the sleepover as their own character and interact with everyone.*
typesense:trending.name: MHA Sleepover
typesense:trending.title: A Chatbot with MHA, students from Class 1-A and Class 1-B is here for a sleepover.

title_i18n.ar: روبوت دردشة مع طلاب MHA من الصف 1-A والصف 1-B في سهرة.
title_i18n.de: Ein Chatbot mit MHA, Schüler aus Klasse 1-A und Klasse 1-B, ist hier für eine Schlafparty.
title_i18n.es: Un chatbot con MHA, estudiantes de la Clase 1-A y la Clase 1-B está aquí para una fiesta de pijamas.
title_i18n.fr: Un chatbot avec MHA, élèves des classes 1-A et 1-B, est là pour une soirée pyjama.
title_i18n.hi: एमएचए के साथ एक चैटबॉट, क्लास 1-ए और क्लास 1-बी के छात्र यहां स्लीपओवर के लिए हैं।
title_i18n.it: Un chatbot con MHA, studenti della Classe 1-A e Classe 1-B è qui per un pigiama party.
title_i18n.pl: Chatbot z MHA, uczniowie z Klasy 1-A i Klasy 1-B są tutaj na nocowaniu.
title_i18n.pt: Um chatbot com MHA, estudantes da Turma 1-A e Turma 1-B está aqui para uma pijamada.
title_i18n.ru: Чат-бот с MHA, студентами из класса 1-A и класса 1-B на ночевке.
title_i18n.tr: MHA ile bir sohbet botu, 1-A Sınıfı ve 1-B Sınıfı öğrencilerinden oluşan grup pijama partisi için burada.
